component.name: LibertyX Partition
component.summary: Recover files and partitions, and manage disks
Recuperar arquivos e partições, e cuidar dos discos

description.p: Disk tool focused on data recovery: deleted files (NTFS, FAT, exFAT, ext2/3/4, HFS+, APFS), lost partitions, deep scan by file signature, disk imaging with bad-sector handling, surface test and S.M.A.R.T.

Also partitions: create, resize (online grow of ext4, XFS and Btrfs), move, format (ext4, XFS, Btrfs, F2FS, NTFS, exFAT, FAT32, swap, LUKS2), check, label and UUID, flags, GPT/MBR conversion without data loss, clone and copy, LUKS and BitLocker unlock, LVM and RAID.

Ferramenta de discos com foco em recuperação de dados: arquivos apagados, partições perdidas, varredura profunda, imagem de disco, teste de superfície e S.M.A.R.T. — e o gerenciamento completo das partições.
